"""Offline regression checks using temporary files and synthetic values only."""
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest

from app_health_checker.config import ConfigError
from app_health_checker.history import History
from app_health_checker.mail import safe_result
from app_health_checker.models import CheckResult
from app_health_checker.settings import safe_backup, restore_backup


class HistoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.history = History(self.root / "history.sqlite3")
        self.assertIsNone(self.history.error)
        with self.history.connect() as db:
            for app, status in (("A", "PASS"), ("A", "FAIL"), ("B", "FAIL")):
                db.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO results (app_id,display_name,status,safe_summary) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                    (app, "Synthetic " + app, status, "=synthetic"),
                )
        self.csv = self.root / "results.csv"

    def read_csv(self):
        with self.csv.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
            return list(csv.DictReader(stream))

    def test_filtered_export_and_formula_protection(self):
        self.history.export(self.csv, rows=self.history.rows("A", "FAIL"))
        rows = self.read_csv()
        self.assertEqual([(r["app_id"], r["status"]) for r in rows], [("A", "FAIL")])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["safe_summary"], " =synthetic")

    def test_empty_snapshot_exports_no_history_rows(self):
        self.history.export(self.csv, rows=[])
        self.assertEqual(self.read_csv(), [])
        self.assertIn("app_id", self.csv.read_text().splitlines()[0])

    def test_reopen_preserves_records(self):
        reopened = History(self.root / "history.sqlite3")
        self.assertEqual(
            [(r["app_id"], r["status"]) for r in reopened.rows()],
            [("B", "FAIL"), ("A", "FAIL"), ("A", "PASS")],
        )


class SettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.temp.name) / "backup.json"
        self.mail = {
            "transport": "outlook",
            "sender": "test@example.invalid",
            "recipients": ["test@example.invalid"],
        }

    def test_outlook_transport_survives_backup_restore(self):
        backup = safe_backup({"mail": self.mail}, {})
        self.path.write_text(json.dumps(backup), encoding="utf-8")
        restored = restore_backup(self.path, [])
        self.assertEqual(restored["local"]["mail"], self.mail)

    def test_backup_excludes_password_and_restore_rejects_injection(self):
        backup = safe_backup({"mail": dict(self.mail, password="SYNTHETIC-SECRET")}, {})
        self.assertNotIn("password", backup["local"]["mail"])
        backup["local"]["mail"]["password"] = "SYNTHETIC-SECRET"
        self.path.write_text(json.dumps(backup), encoding="utf-8")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            restore_backup(self.path, [])


class DiagnosticTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_numeric_step_survives_but_sensitive_text_is_redacted(self):
        result = CheckResult("Synthetic", "Checkout", "browser", "FAIL", "Failed", details=[
            {"step": 1, "action": "click", "selector": "ok", "status": "FAIL"},
            {"step": "check SYNTHETIC-SECRET", "action": "SYNTHETIC-SECRET", "status": "FAIL"},
        ])
        text = safe_result(result, ("1", "SYNTHETIC-SECRET"))[3]
        self.assertIn("step: 1; action: click; selector: ok", text)
        self.assertNotIn("SYNTHETIC-SECRET", text)
        self.assertIn("step: check [REDACTED]", text)

    def test_numeric_text_is_still_redacted(self):
        result = CheckResult("Synthetic", "Checkout", "browser", "FAIL", "Failed",
                             details=[{"step": "1", "status": "FAIL"}])
        self.assertIn("step: [REDACTED]", safe_result(result, ("1",))[3])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
